response.sql: SELECT SUM(StateTotal) AS total_sum, AVG(InvoiceCount) AS avg_invoices_per_state FROM (SELECT c.State, SUM(i.Total) AS StateTotal, COUNT(i.InvoiceId) AS InvoiceCount FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId WHERE i.InvoiceDate >= '2010-06-22 00:00:00' AND i.InvoiceDate <= '2012-06-26 00:00:00' GROUP BY c.State) AS state_summary
